descriptions: Produced construction documents in Revit for a 64-unit affordable housing building, from design development through permit
Coordinated drawings with structural and mechanical consultants and tracked 140 RFIs during construction administration
Built the daylight and energy models that helped the project reach its Passive House target
Join site visits every two weeks and write the field reports sent to the contractor and owner
Drew schematic options and renderings for three school renovations, two of which went on to construction
Set up the office's Revit family library, which cut setup time on new projects by about a day
Built physical and digital models for client meetings and the firm's competition entries
Thesis: mass timber housing for steep urban lots, selected for the school's annual exhibition
